title: The boat pits as acid-filled circuit breakers

tellings.quote: So inside the boat pits adjacent to the Great Pyramid, we find more sulfate compounds.

plain: A pyramid researcher named Geoffrey Drumm says the boat pits, long trenches cut into the rock beside the Great Pyramid at Giza in Egypt, once held acid and worked as circuit breakers. He tells Michels that "inside the boat pits adjacent to the Great Pyramid, we find more sulfate compounds", which he takes as leftover traces of that chemistry. If true, the pyramid would have been part of an electrical machine rather than only a tomb.
